title: Recommend a new host — you can get their first-month commission
sub: Know someone with a phone who likes to talk, sing, pray, cook or dance? Refer them to Roxy. When that new host hits their first-month bean and live-hour target, you can receive that host’s first-month *agency commission* (this is separate from the host’s own salary).
body: Message the WhatsApp group with the accounts you invited. Paid when the new host reaches their bean and live-hour target, following the BIGO Africa structure. Everybody is welcome — refer as many as you can.
button: Tell us about a new host
buttonMessage: Hello Roxy, I want to refer a new host
